description: This file defines the StateHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class manages lifecycle state transitions, including initializing states, validating state transitions, updating states, sending events, and maintaining transition mappings. It includes declarations for static functions and static members related to lifecycle management, such as createState, isValidTransition, updateState, sendEvent, getStatePath, and transition maps.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling lifecycle state transitions, including validation, creation, and event notification within the framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateHandler, setting up necessary state transition structures.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Performs a transition to a new lifecycle state based on the provided request, returning success or failure.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a state object for a given application context and lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Validates whether transitioning from start to target state is permissible within the defined transition path.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the application context to a new lifecycle state and reports any errors.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends lifecycle state change events to notify relevant components.

methods.name: getStatePath
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence of states from the current to the desired lifecycle state.
